problem: Wake listener repeatedly answered itself after audible playback. Bad interactions were promoted from weak transcripts including 'oh man', 'we have accomplished quite a bit', and 'to a while men to'.

changes.change: Removed 'oh man' from probable wake fallback transcript whitelist.
Added configurable cooldown_seconds argument sourced from MIM_WAKE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.
Set MIM_WAKE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=45 for the user service.
Removed broad probable-wake guessing and narrowed wake aliases so random transcripts like 'men' do not trigger responses.
Changed acknowledgement to voice-only playback and removed the three-tone preamble from generated response WAVs.

training_lesson.rule: Do not treat ambiguous recognition fragments as wake intent. Wake response must come from explicit wake language, not generic speech, volume, or weak phonetic aliases.
training_lesson.future_recovery_action: When repeated wake responses occur, inspect the last transcript and wake transcript, remove weak fallback matches, disable guess-based wake promotion, and verify status remains listening after at least one cooldown interval.
